support_quote: Participants who did not demonstrate adequate adherence to the treatment protocol after randomization were not included in the final analyses.
In the RGBEG, 3 participants were lost to follow-up because of personal reasons and insufficient brace use. The final analyses included 20 participants, with 10 participants in each group.
because participants' awareness of group allocation may have influenced responses to self-reported measures such as the WRVAS, MSPPA, and SUS, these findings should be interpreted cautiously
